snippet.title: Militsioner | Demo Available Now | CRTime
snippet.description:
Militsioner is getting its very first public demo, available right now, only on Steam.
Play the first act of the game, where you meet colourful NPCs, a Colossal Policeman and learn how to survive while you try to leave this surreal town.

The demo features one main way of escaping the town, but there are a number of paths to freedom, so get creative! 

Coming 2027 to Steam, XBOX Game Pass, XBOX on PC, XBOX Series X|S

Play Demo on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4627010/Militsioner_Demo/
